name: anki
description: Anki is a smart spaced repetition flashcard program
one_liner: A flashcard app that quizzes you right before you're about to forget something, so you retain facts using far less study time than normal rereading.
buyer: A test-prep company or medical/language school that wants to sell a proven study method without building spaced-repetition software from scratch.
business_use_cases: A language-learning tutor sells a professionally built deck plus a short onboarding course on top of the free app.
A medical-board-exam prep company packages a curated, well-tested deck and charges students for it.
A corporate training team uses it internally, for free, to help employees retain compliance material longer.

money_ideas.idea: Sell curated, high-quality decks for a specific exam or subject
Sell a companion course that teaches how to study effectively with spaced repetition

steal_this: This weekend, build and sell one excellent curated deck for a specific certification exam — the app itself is free and already trusted, so the deck is the whole product.
